episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: In Naples in 1997, Pietro Savastano has dreams of following in the footsteps of local gangster Angelo. Crime drama prequel, starring Luca Lubran.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: Angelo receives an invitation that could improve his situation, while Pietro comes face to face with reality and realises that dreams are nt for everyone.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Angelo is forced to make a pact and gets help from Pietro to put his plan into action.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: Angelo is put in serious danger and Pietro knows he cannot abandon him, while Imma steps in to help Annalisa at any cost

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: Pietro and Imma come to terms with what happened the night before, while Angelo seems to have finally got everything he wants.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: Angelo suffers a terrible blow and though he says he does not want revenge, only Pietro understands what he really has in mind.
